discovery.purpose: Cheap, bounded code and documentation discovery

implementation.purpose: Routine implementation; inherits coordinator when unspecified

review.purpose: Independent candidate review; prefer the opposite OpenAI/Claude family from implementation

complex.purpose: Difficult debugging or broad changes; inherits coordinator when unspecified

judge.purpose: Separate cross-family judge after all proposals finish

instruction: Select modelChoice when spawning. Missing model/provider inherit the task selection. Explicit overrides require modelReason. Availability is checked before launch; a rejected choice is not a reason to guess another model ID.
